name: 到期管家
description: Track due dates and selected Apple Reminders with 130 offline SF Symbols in 11 App Store-inspired groups, expanded subscription matching, manual overrides, and legacy icon compatibility.

localizedDescriptions.zh: 通过原生风格桌面组件管理信用卡、订阅、周期事项与指定提醒事项列表，内置 130 个离线 SF Symbols、11 个常见方向分组及更丰富的订阅匹配，并保留手动覆盖和旧图标兼容。
